entities.summary: Alessandro Pajola is an Italian professional basketball player and the team captain for Virtus Bologna of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA) and the EuroLeague. He is also a member of the senior Italian national team. Standing at 1.94 m, he plays at the point guard position. Pajola is widely known for his defensive ability.
